subject: general
question: One of the mission under the National Action Plan for Climate Change (NAPCC) published by Govt. of India in 2008 is:

options.text: National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem** is one of the missions under the National Action Plan for Climate Change (NAPCC) published by the Government of India in 2008.
 
• The NAPCC comprises **eight missions** which focus on various aspects of climate change and sustainable development.
 
• These missions aim to promote understanding of climate change, adaptation, mitigation, energy efficiency, and natural resource conservation.
 
• The **National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem** aims to understand the complex processes affecting the Himalayan ecosystem and evolve suitable management and policy measures for sustaining and safeguarding the Himalayan glaciers and mountain ecosystems.
 
• Other missions under NAPCC include the **National Solar Mission, National Mission for Enhanced Energy Efficiency, National Mission on Sustainable Habitat**, and others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Action Plan for Climate Change (NAPCC)** was launched by the Prime Minister's Council on Climate Change in June 2008.
 
• It primarily focuses on promoting understanding of climate change, adaptation, mitigation, energy efficiency, and conservation of natural resources.
 
• The NAPCC is guided by the principles of protecting the poor and vulnerable sections of society through an inclusive and sustainable development strategy.
 
• It also emphasizes the importance of international cooperation and the need for a global effort in addressing climate change.
